subject: Firefighter Equipment Appropriation and Public Safety
overview: The Council authorized nearly $300,000 for new Fire Department breathing apparatus and debated citywide strategies for graffiti removal. Members also addressed a recent surge in West Medford break-ins and discussed zoning changes for front-yard parking.

items.title: License Approvals
items.summary: Approved common victualler and business licenses for Wellington Switzerland and Juiced Cafe.

items.title: Graffiti Removal and Remediation
items.summary: Approved a resolution demanding graffiti removal at the Bigelow building and requesting the city investigate purchasing removal equipment and adopting a liability waiver program for private owners.

items.title: Congratulatory Resolutions
items.summary: Approved resolutions congratulating Frederick Forestier on his 80th birthday and Mrs. Lepore for receiving the Mustang Spirit Award.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Referral
items.summary: Referred a proposal to modify zoning ordinances regarding front yard parking and frontage requirements to the Zoning and Ordinance Subcommittee.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Exemptions
items.summary: Requested that the administration publicize eligibility requirements and application deadlines for CPA tax exemptions available to seniors and low-income residents.

items.title: SeeClickFix Coordination
items.summary: Requested an administration report on the SeeClickFix program, specifically regarding the city's role in coordinating repairs for issues reported on state-owned property.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: A resident inquired about the structural status of the police station and questioned the $25,000 cost of a commission for a Medford Square shelter.

items.title: Fire Department Breathing Apparatus Appropriation
items.summary: Approved a $281,888 appropriation for new self-contained breathing apparatus for the Fire Department, pending a potential 90 percent reimbursement from a federal grant.

items.title: Community Recognition and Minutes
items.summary: Recognized a local fundraising event and approved the minutes of the March 29 meeting as amended.

items.title: West Medford Crime and Community Policing
items.summary: Discussed a recent surge in break-ins in West Medford and called for a public safety summit and the reinstatement of community policing patrols.
